title: Data and deletion
intro: Export all data of your organization here, or delete it.
ownersOnly: Only owners of the organization can export its data or delete it.
loadError: The exports could not be loaded.

export.title: Data export
export.description: The export holds all data of {organization} as a ZIP archive: one JSON file per table and the originals of the media library. Secrets such as the tokens of connected accounts are left out.
export.requested: The export was requested. You will get an email as soon as it is ready.
export.inProgress: An export is being created. Depending on the amount of data this takes a few minutes.
export.availability: A finished export can be downloaded for 24 hours and is deleted after that. Every download creates a link that works for five minutes and is recorded in the audit log.

deletion.title: Delete organization
deletion.description: Deletes {organization} with all workspaces, posts, media, connected accounts and statistics. All members lose access at once, scheduled posts are no longer published, and a paid subscription ends with the current period.
deletion.delay: The data is erased for good after 30 days. Until then owners can take the deletion back here. Download a data export first if you want to keep the data.
deletion.dialogDescription: Type the name of the organization to confirm. After 30 days the deletion cannot be undone.
deletion.deleted: The organization was deleted. It will be erased for good on {date}.
deletion.pending: {organization} was deleted on {deletedAt} and will be erased for good on {date}. Until then nobody can work in it.
deletion.restored: The deletion was taken back. The organization is available again.
deletion.notice: This organization was deleted and will be erased for good on {date}.
deletion.askOwner: An owner can take the deletion back.
deletion.blockedDescription: Since the deletion nobody can work in it. On {date} it is erased for good with all its data.
